title: Restate
description: Instantly dye or bleach placed blocks, and strip fences and walls connections.
body:
## Restate

### What it does

Restate uses the latest `block_transformer` component added in **26.3** to allow you to instantly dye or bleach placed blocks, and strip fences and walls connections.

* **Dyeing and Bleaching:** Right-click placed colored blocks with any dye to change their color. Use a piece of paper to instantly bleach them back to their original white or clear color.
* **Fence and Wall Stripping:** Use an axe to strip all wooden fences' connections. Or use a pickaxe to do the same for walls.
* **Auto-Replanting Harvester:** Hoes are upgraded with a harvester functionality. Right-clicking fully grown crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes, and beetroots) automatically replants them.

### Compatibility

This data pack is not guaranteed to be compatible with mods or other data packs that modify the same item interactions. Restate adds custom `block_transformer` components to tools and related items, so any pack that changes those items may conflict with it.

### Uninstallation

If you ever need to remove the datapack, run `/function restate:uninstall` to cleanly revoke active advancements.
> **Note:** This won't revert the updated components from items.
